title: 第一卷 第11章 枪法入门第一卷 第12章 上山猎熊
slug: 乱世加点从猎户到武圣只杀不赦
content_zh:
李毅神色未变，不卑不亢的回道：“听到了，那时候我正在去铁匠铺的路上。”
“是吗？”
户曹拖着长音，话锋突然一转，道：“但你一个猎户，为什么会买得起这几十贯钱的长枪？还有你背上的那把弓，也不是便宜货。
你是不是该解释一下？”
此话一出，周边的空气都凝滞了。
服役的武器确实需要自己准备，但被选中的人，往往都是买最便宜的，哪有李毅这条件？
“大人，钱是我向邻居李二牛借的，再有我打猎也换了点钱，你要是不信，尽管找人去调查.....”
李毅说的话半真半假，哪怕户曹真派人去调查，他也不担心，李二牛肯定会配合他。
户曹眯着双眼，不知在思索着什么，片刻之后，突然呵呵一笑。
“竟是如此，倒也合情合理。放行！”
衙役们相互看了看，随后让出一个身位让李毅通行。
李毅对户曹拱了拱手后，走了出去。
刚离开城门口，还走没多久，李毅脚步一顿，微微皱起了眉头。
他的直觉告诉他，后面有人在跟着。
看来那个户曹还是放心不下自己，安排人跟了过来。
不过李毅并未回头，照常往前走去。。
后面尾随的是户曹的两个心腹衙役，李毅前脚刚走，他们就被户曹一个眼神给安排了过来。
常年给户曹卖命，自然是知道他的意思。
估摸着王大贵的死，和这个叫李毅的有关系。
但具体情况，还得查了才知道。

在他们的尾随下，李毅像往常一样，回到了家中。
刚进门，李毅就朝着里边喊道：“小月，你看我给你们带什么来了？”
李月眼睛笑得像个月牙。
“哥，你可算回来了，去了那么久，刘茹姐和小芳姐一直很担心你呢！”
李毅摸了摸她的脑袋，笑道：“跟她们说我回来了，让她们不用担心，不过你们别出门，就在家好好待着，等我回来。”
李月闻言，皱起了眉头，道：“哥，你要去哪？”
李毅笑着道：“去山上一趟，趁着现在还有时间，多打点猎物回来，不然等我去了军营，一个月都不见得能回来一次。”
说到这里，李毅停顿了一下，道：“等我回来，我教你跟小信练武，现在这个世道，想要活下去，只能靠自己。”
李月闻言，脸色也变得认真起来，道：“大哥，我听你的。”
李毅笑着伸手揉了揉妹妹的脑袋，不管是李月还是李信，都是特别懂事的孩子。
他准备先教他们一些基础的东西，看看他们有没有天赋。
要是没有练武的天赋，再想其他的出路。
交代完事情后，李毅又去看了下李信，见李信还好好的躺在床上休息，这才转身出了门。
之后李毅径直地往山上走去。
本以为那两个衙役应该会跟上来，但他走了好一会，都没发现有人跟着。
难不成他们放弃了？还是说去找李二牛验证了？
至于他们会不会跑去自己家里找李月她们，李毅并不担心。
因为他已经留下了应对的手段，也告诉了弟弟妹妹在紧急情况下该怎么做。
那俩人要真敢对他们出手，保证有去无回。
等了差不多一刻钟，发现还是无人跟上，李毅才继续上山。

这座山名为百木林，这里树木茂盛，遮天蔽日，野兽也多。
据一些老猎户说，这里还有老虎出没。
所以很多猎户只敢在边缘徘徊，不敢深入。
李毅现在艺高人胆大，倒不担心遇到野兽。
而且这里没什么人，正是修炼的好时机。
content_en:
Li Yi's expression did not change, and he replied neither humble nor arrogant: "I heard it, I was on the way to the blacksmith shop at that time."
"Really?"
Hu Cao drawled a long voice and suddenly changed the subject, saying: "But you, a hunter, can afford to buy a spear worth dozens of dollars? And the bow on your back is not cheap either.
Should you explain? "
As soon as these words came out, the surrounding air became stagnant.
Weapons for service do need to be prepared by yourself, but the chosen ones often buy the cheapest ones. How can Li Yi have such conditions?
"Sir, I borrowed the money from my neighbor Li Erniu. I also exchanged some money for hunting. If you don't believe it, just ask someone to investigate..."
What Li Yi said was half true and half false. Even if Hucao really sent someone to investigate, he would not worry. Li Erniu would definitely cooperate with him.
Hu Cao squinted his eyes, wondering what he was thinking about. After a moment, he suddenly laughed.
"That's the case, it makes sense. Let's go!"
The government officials looked at each other, and then gave up a position to let Li Yi pass.
Li Yi bowed his hands to Hu Cao and walked out.
Just after leaving the city gate, Li Yi paused and frowned slightly.
His instinct told him that someone was following him.
It seemed that Hu Cao still couldn't worry about himself and arranged for someone to follow him.
However, Li Yi did not look back and walked forward as usual. .
Following behind were two of Hu Cao's confidants. As soon as Li Yi left, they were ordered over by Hu Cao's look.
Having worked for Hu Cao all year round, she naturally knew what he meant.
It is estimated that Wang Dagui's death has something to do with this man named Li Yi.
But the specific situation needs to be investigated to know.
Following them, Li Yi returned home as usual.
As soon as he entered the door, Li Yi shouted inside: "Xiaoyue, do you see what I brought you?"
Li Yue's eyes smiled like crescent moons.
"Brother, you are finally back. Sister Liu Ru and Sister Xiaofang have been worried about you for so long!"
Li Yi touched her head and said with a smile: "Tell them that I am back, so that they don't have to worry, but don't go out, just stay at home and wait for me to come back."
Hearing this, Li Yue frowned and said, "Brother, where are you going?"
Li Yi smiled and said: "Go to the mountains and catch more prey while there is still time. Otherwise, when I go to the military camp, I may not be able to come back even once in a month."
At this point, Li Yi paused and said: "When I come back, I will teach you to practice martial arts with Xiao Xin. In this world, if you want to survive, you can only rely on yourself."
When Li Yue heard this, her expression became serious and she said, "Brother, I listen to you."
Li Yi smiled and stretched out his hand to rub his sister's head. Both Li Yue and Li Xin were very sensible children.
He planned to teach them some basic things first to see if they had any talent.
If you don't have the talent for martial arts, think of other ways out.
After explaining the matter, Li Yi went to see Li Xin again. Seeing that Li Xin was still lying on the bed and resting well, he turned around and went out.
After that, Li Yi walked straight up the mountain.
He thought that the two government officials would follow him, but he walked for a while and didn't find anyone following him.
Could it be that they gave up? Or should I go to Li Erniu to verify it?
As for whether they would go to their home to find Li Yue and the others, Li Yi was not worried.
Because he has left behind the means of coping and told his younger siblings what to do in an emergency.
If those two people really dare to attack them, they will never come back.
After waiting for almost a quarter of an hour, Li Yi continued to go up the mountain after finding that no one was following him.
This mountain is called Baimulin. The trees here are lush, blocking out the sky and the sun, and there are many wild animals.
According to some old hunters, there are still tigers here.
Therefore, many hunters only dare to linger on the edge and dare not go deep.
Li YiNowadays, people with good skills are bold and don’t worry about encountering wild beasts.
And there are no people here, so it is a good time to practice.
